trust_decision.summary: When a client-supplied IRI is resolved to an object during denormalisation, the resolved object must be an instance of the declared relation/resource class; at the pinned commit the serializer resolves the IRI without passing the expected operation, so the IriConverter's own class guard is skipped and any resource type is accepted.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'relation IRIs ... denormalised'; denormalizeRelation in the core serializer is the obvious relation-IRI resolver.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST/PUT/PATCH body in any format whose value for a resource-typed field is a bare IRI string (top-level denormalize of a resource class from a string, e.g. via denormalizeRelation's writable-link recursion or direct serializer->denormalize)
HTTP POST/PUT/PATCH body (JSON, JSON-LD, GraphQL mutation input) with a relation property, single or collection, given as IRI string(s)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both published sites are in one file; the second implementation (JsonApi denormalizeRelation override) was NOT touched by the fix and is recorded in O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: JSON:API overrides denormalizeRelation in its own package and requires a resource-linkage object with a 'type' member, so a solver can argue it is a separate format with its own linkage semantics and not the 'relation IRI string' the report describes.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A relation declared as a parent class/interface must still accept IRIs of subclass resources (is_a, not exact class match); collection relations and denormalize_throw_on_relation_not_found=false (null on missing item) and the nested writable-link path must keep working. An exact-class (===) or get_class comparison breaks inheritance/Doctrine proxies.

O6_input_shapes: relation given as single IRI string (src/Serializer/AbstractItemNormalizer.php:616-618)
to-many relation given as array of IRI strings, routed per element through denormalizeRelation (src/Serializer/AbstractItemNormalizer.php:587,598)
resource class denormalised directly from an IRI string (src/Serializer/AbstractItemNormalizer.php:228-230)

O7_producer.where: The resolved object comes from IriConverter::getResourceFromIri -> state provider (src/Symfony/Routing/IriConverter.php:65-104); the converter is called by the check site, not a hidden producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JSON:API relationship linkage {type,id}: JsonApi ItemNormalizer overrides denormalizeRelation and resolves value['id'] without any class check and without passing the operation; the 'type' member is required but ignored.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate format package with its own override and linkage object (not an IRI string); report example is JSON-LD string IRIs.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (src/JsonApi vs src/Serializer), different file; reached only with application/vnd.api+json

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JSON:API top-level data.id resolved to object_to_populate without operation/class check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the root document identity on update, not a relation; Symfony's object-to-populate handling may drop a wrong-typed object (vendor code not available to verify).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package, same file as route above

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Plain JSON 'id' update path resolves data['id'] to object_to_populate without passing the operation, so no class guard.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Root-object update lookup, not a relation; JSON-LD equivalent passes the operation (src/JsonLd/Serializer/ItemNormalizer.php:181) and is guarded.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HAL denormalize currently throws (never); a HAL _links-based relation denormalizer resolving href without class check would be a realistic sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HAL is the only hypermedia format without input support; a maintainer adding it would copy the JsonApi override pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Laravel IriConverter ignores the $operation argument entirely (no is_a guard like src/Symfony/Routing/IriConverter.php:86), so a fix that relies on passing the operation is ineffective under Laravel.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Already real: second IriConverter implementation in another package; a solver fixing by passing the operation would leave Laravel open (HOW-type).

O9_family: type confusion / missing object-type validation on reference resolution (CWE-843)

O10_build.project_tests: src/Serializer/Tests/AbstractItemNormalizerTest.php, src/JsonApi/Tests/Serializer/ItemNormalizerTest.php, tests/Functional (fix adds tests/Functional/Security/TypeConfusionRelationIriTest.php); functional tests can use SQLite

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add is_a check (or pass the operation) only in AbstractItemNormalizer::denormalizeRelation, leaving the JsonApi override and the Laravel IriConverter (which ignores the operation) unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: GraphQL item queries resolve the id IRI without a class check; only Mutation/Subscription compare classes (src/GraphQl/State/Provider/ReadProvider.php:66-78). Read-side, not denormalisation.
IriConverterParameterProvider resolves IRIs with no expected class (src/State/ParameterProvider/IriConverterParameterProvider.php:46,54). Experimental feature, no declared target class.
unverified: Symfony ObjectToPopulateTrait instanceof behaviour for wrong-typed object_to_populate (vendor not installed); affects whether the two root-identity O8 routes are exploitable.
